agenda_text:
AGENDA
  PARKLANDS COMMITTEE
  JUNE 8, 2015

Council Chambers  Monday
City Hall  June 8, 2015
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  7:30 p.m.
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in
appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the
Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 378-0383, at least 48
hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.

Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on
all appropriate items on Tuesday, June 23, 2015.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC

Members of the audience are invited to address the Committee at this time on items that
are not otherwise on the agenda. Per the California Government Code Section 54954.2,
the Parklands Committee is prohibited from discussing or taking immediate action on any
item not on the agenda unless it can be demonstrated that the item is of an emergency
nature, or the need to take action arose subsequent to the posting of the agenda.

ACTION MEMO

  JUNE 8, 2015

Council Chambers  Monday
City Hall  June 8, 2015
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  7:30 p.m.
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on
all appropriate items on Tuesday, June 23, 2015.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL  Members present: Peterson, Kaviani, Rubincam and Wade

  Members absent: none

COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC

Members of the audience are invited to address the Committee at this time on items that
are not otherwise on the agenda. Per the California Government Code Section 54954.2,
the Parklands Committee is prohibited from discussing or taking immediate action on any
item not on the agenda unless it can be demonstrated that the item is of an emergency
nature, or the need to take action arose subsequent to the posting of the agenda.

CITIZEN APPLICATION

1.  PC-396-15; Application to remove 2 Olive trees located in the parkway adjacent
  to 933 Via Rincon

  Applicant:  Daniel O. Booker
  1443 Via Castilla
  Palos Verdes Estates CA 90274

Applicant has requested a continuance to a later Parklands Committee meeting.

 Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on all
  appropriate items on Tuesday, June 23, 2015.
 2.  PC-399-15; Application to remove 1 Carob tree located in the parkway adjacent
  to 2609 Via Rivera

  Applicant:  Marisa and John Kunich
  2609 Via Rivera
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Applicant has requested a continuance

3.  PC-400-15; Application to remove 1 Carob tree located in the parkway adjacent
  to 717 Via Del Monte and 1 Jacaranda located in the parkway adjacent to 718 Via
  Del Monte

  Applicant:  Dave Oberman
  812 Via Conejo
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Continued to a later Parklands Committee meeting.

NEW BUSINESS

4.  Policy for accepting boulders for projects within the City.

Action: Peterson motioned seconded by Rubincam to recommend boulders and
rocks be granted an exemption to the ‘Policy for Gifts to the City’ to be
environmentally sensitive and protect a natural amenity of the City. The vote was
4-0.

OLD BUSINESS

5.  Changes to Parklands Application

Action: Peterson motioned seconded by Kaviani to approve the ‘Change to
Parklands Application’. The vote was 4-0.

ITEMS OF INFORMATION FROM THE COMMITTEE/STAFF

6.  Update on current applications

Received and filed.

 Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on all
  appropriate items on Tuesday, June 23, 2015.
 7.  Water use for public landscapes

Staff was directed to provide more information for the next Parklands Committee
meeting.

ADJOURNMENT

 Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on all
  appropriate items on Tuesday, June 23, 2015.
